jcr:title: A Commitment to Surgeon Education
jcr:description:
We believe that broadening your experience and knowledge through the latest educational programs and technologies allows Stryker to help improve healthcare worldwide. Our goal is to develop meaningful learning opportunities that meet your unique needs at every stage of you career.

Our integrated programs and education innovations targeting surgeons residents and fellows can be used to forge a personalized education pathway that meets your specific education goals, appeals to your personal learning style and fits within your busy schedule. Review the options below with your Stryker sales representative and work together to create your personalized Education Pathway.

text.text: Creating educational pathways for all levels

text_copy.text:
We believe that broadening your experience and knowledge through the latest educational programs and technologies allows Stryker to help improve healthcare worldwide. Our goal is to develop meaningful learning opportunities that meet your unique needs at every stage of your career: residency, fellowship and throughout practice.

Contact your Stryker sales representative to create your personalized Education Pathway or learn more about training programs, including Mako SmartRobotics™ Certification, Revision Simplified and Direct Anterior Approach by visiting StrykersTrainingAcademy.com and begin your on-demand learning journey today.

experiencefragment.text: Stryker's Training Academy The on-demand learning platform Digital learning for a digital age. Driven by expertise, focused on outcomes. Explore diverse surgical cases and techniques Access dynamic on-demand content Choose short and long form videos Discover real-world case studies Dive into educational papers and in-depth articles Sign In to Stryker's Training Academy JR45 JR45 is Stryker’s interactive and on-demand monthly education series focused on the latest techniques and technologies in hip and knee arthroplasty. Each month, we’ll launch on-demand learning content and host a 45-minute faculty-led webinar featuring live case reviews and decision-making discussions. Register for JR45 here

text_copy_copy.text:
Customer experience programs


The Customer Experience Program is an invitation to healthcare professionals to visit our locations and engage with our brand marketing, product development, clinical teams, and leadership, with a focus on our products, technologies, and manufacturing capabilities.

In-person surgical observations


Surgical Observations are premier surgeon-to-surgeon product and procedural training. Surgeons have the opportunity to participate in a case performed by one of our experienced faculty members in the faculty's operating room.

text_copy.text:
Surgical training programs

 

Surgical Training Programs are hands-on comprehensive courses featuring small, interactive discussions, learning activities and intensive cadaveric surgical skills sessions guided by experienced surgeon faculty.

text_copy_copy_copy.text: For more information on hands-on learning opportunities, please reach out to your sales representative!

text_copy_copy.text:
Mentor call


Schedule a one-on-one discussion with a surgeon faculty member to discuss cases, address orthopaedic issues, and learn procedural tips and tricks.

text_copy_copy_74288.text:
Virtual surgical observations

Virtual Surgical Observations transport you into an OR to watch a procedure from multiple views and dialogue directly with the operating surgeon in real time, without leaving your office. Contact your sales representative to schedule a one-on-one VSO or register for a pre-scheduled Mako VSO to supplement your Mako learning journey.
